mapper.insert: INSERT INTO orders ( account_id, order_code, subtotal_amount, shipping_fee, total_amount, order_status, payment_status, payment_method, shipping_full_name, shipping_phone_number, shipping_address ) VALUES ( #{accountId}, #{orderCode}, #{subtotalAmount}, #{shippingFee}, #{totalAmount}, #{orderStatus}, #{paymentStatus}, #{paymentMethod}, #{shippingFullName}, #{shippingPhoneNumber}, #{shippingAddress} )

INSERT INTO order_items ( order_id, product_id, product_name, unit_price, quantity, subtotal ) VALUES
( #{item.orderId}, #{item.productId}, #{item.productName}, #{item.unitPrice}, #{item.quantity}, #{item.subtotal} )
mapper.select: SELECT id AS order_id, account_id, order_code, subtotal_amount, shipping_fee, total_amount, order_status, payment_status, payment_method, shipping_full_name, shipping_phone_number, shipping_address, created_at, updated_at FROM orders WHERE account_id = #{accountId} ORDER BY created_at DESC

SELECT o.id AS order_id, o.account_id, o.order_code, o.subtotal_amount, o.shipping_fee, o.total_amount, o.order_status, o.payment_status, o.payment_method, o.shipping_full_name, o.shipping_phone_number, o.shipping_address, o.created_at, o.updated_at, oi.id AS item_id, oi.product_id, oi.product_name, oi.unit_price, oi.quantity, oi.subtotal FROM orders o LEFT JOIN order_items oi ON o.id = oi.order_id WHERE o.id = #{orderId}
AND o.account_id = #{accountId}
mapper.update: UPDATE orders SET order_status = #{orderStatus}, payment_status = #{paymentStatus}, updated_at = NOW() WHERE id = #{orderId}
